A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 22-page versions of the same FSGDM study. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-E are readable and can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v2 reports original image-classification, IWSLT14 translation, and MuJoCo reinforcement-learning experiments, alongside momentum-coefficient studies and Appendix C ablations.

after.justification: v5 retains these original experiments, including the benchmark results in Tables 3-4 and Figure 5 and the supplementary results in Appendix C.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 retains the same FSGDM update, stagewise momentum schedule, scaling of mu with total training steps, and fixed gradient coefficient. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, ImageNet, IWSLT14 German-English translation, and the same Walker2d-v4, HalfCheetah-v4, and Ant-v4 environments. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: EMA-SGDM and Standard-SGDM remain the benchmark comparators in Tables 3-4 and Figure 5. The dynamic-sequence alternatives and special momentum systems in Appendix C also retain identical comparator membership.

E3.justification: Sections 3-5 and Appendix D retain the same architectures, training budgets, learning rates, preprocessing, batch sizes, and metrics. Reinforcement-learning evaluation still uses ten episodes every 30,000 steps.

E4.justification: The coefficient studies and Appendix C analyses are unchanged, including sequence comparisons, early-training behavior, filter-direction tests, extreme coefficients, optimal-parameter zones, and the batch-size ablation. No analytical question or supporting experiment is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both retain three-run accuracy summaries using seeds 0-2 and standard errors, plus reinforcement-learning results using ten seeds, 0-9, and 75% confidence bands. Run-count disclosures and uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged throughout the main text and Appendix C. For example, both report FSGDM accuracy of 81.44% for ResNet50 on CIFAR-100 in Table 3 and Transformer performance of 32.40 BLEU in Table 4.

T1.justification: The quasi-stationary approximation, transfer function, magnitude and phase responses, Proposition 1, and the derivations and proof in Appendices A-B are unchanged. No mathematical assumption, result, or reasoning is revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same frequency-domain framework, three gradient-frequency findings, and claim that FSGDM outperforms conventional SGD-based momentum optimizers. Contribution scope and novelty claims do not change.

C2.justification: The interpretations concerning early-gradient preservation, late high-frequency suppression, and low-frequency amplification retain the same meaning. Appendix E preserves the same challenges and uncertainty about extending the analysis to Adam and RMSprop.

D1.justification: The implementation and hyperparameter disclosures, PyTorch/FairSeq/Tianshou information, RTX 4090/A100 hardware details, and data-processing instructions are unchanged. The FSGDM code-access footnote and link target are also identical.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Replacing 'Hochreiter et al.' with 'Hochreiter & Schmidhuber' corrects attribution of the same 1997 LSTM reference; abbreviated author names and standardized venue text are bibliographic edits.

P1.justification: v5 expands CNNs in Section 3.3, shortens 'CNNs on Image Classification' to 'Image Classification,' corrects 'Correspondence author,' and standardizes reference formatting. These are limited editorial changes; section and appendix organization remain intact.

P2.justification: The first-page author separators and affiliation superscripts change, and shortened bibliography entries reflow across pages 11-13. Figures 1-14 and Tables 1-9 retain their content, captions, designs, and placement; appendix pages are visually identical.

improvement.justification: v5 provides light editorial polish, including clearer affiliation notation and corrected LSTM attribution. The scientific argument, experimental evidence, proofs, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including all appendices. These small presentation corrections do not materially change the paper's overall quality.
